inspiration: test_decompiling_x8664_cvs; angr variable recovery (one variable per storage location, declared once); main

decisions.question: Scope, correctness, dedup-key, generalization, change_kind, default for the duplicate-declaration collapse.

decider_verdict.scope_reason: S9 emit-time filter: one new module (kuna_dedupvardecls.rs) and three ported-core anchor files (printc.rs gated skip in emit_local_var_decls, architecture.rs flag/seam, options.rs KUNA_OPTION_NAMES). Modelable as a single gated early-return inside an existing emit loop (the composite collapse at printc.rs:2020-2034 is the exact precedent); touches no S7/region code, needs no new pass type. 3 anchor files == the gate ceiling, 1 module < the >1 ceiling, so it stays small.
decider_verdict.correctness_reason: Collapsing decls whose fully-rendered signature (type + name + array adornment + storage comment) is byte-identical cannot hide a variable the body distinguishes: the body refers to every such high by the single shared name only, so multiple identical decl lines are indistinguishable noise and are in fact invalid C re-declarations. Highs that render the same name but a different type/storage have different signatures and both survive. Purely a presentation suppressor on the already-computed decl list; never alters statement-body markup, naming, or which highs exist.
decider_verdict.dedup_key: (final declarator type, name, array adornment, storage comment) — the full rendered signature
decider_verdict.dedup_key_reason: By-name-only would wrongly merge distinct same-named locals differing in type/storage; by-storage-only ignores type and may merge a global/piece sharing a slot. The full rendered signature suppresses a line ONLY when the emitted bytes would be character-for-character identical — provably lossless — and mirrors the existing composite collapse's intent while being safe for scalars (Rc-identity is not, since every int4 shares one type Rc).
decider_verdict.generalizes: General — the root cause is structural (angr naming maps many scalar HighVariables on one slot to one name+type+storage; the printer walks highs not the ScopeLocal Symbol table). Any function with heavily-reused stack scalars under angr naming reproduces it; cvs/main is an extreme instance (~166x).
decider_verdict.default_reason: Land output-changing behavior behind a flag first per kuna convention; graduate to default-ON once the cvs ablation is clean and speed is unaffected. Acknowledged default-ON is defensible given the strong correctness argument (suppresses only byte-identical, strictly-invalid re-declarations).

decisions.final_decision: Shipped DEFAULT-ON (DIV-7). The Phase-5 gate (0/675 upstream assertions change with default-ON AND speed +0.14% within the 5% budget) is met, which the protocol resolves as a default flip; the decider's strong correctness argument (lossless removal of invalid C re-declarations) supports it. The off-pass remains available via `option dedupvardecls off`.
